purpose: Unblock the authenticated PLATFORM_OWNER from creating and activating the existing bounded CONTROL_PLANE staff-access session required to review the two verified PC-CROP registration applications, while preserving current authorization, MFA, CSRF and audit boundaries.
requiredInvariants: The bootstrap is visible only for a real active PLATFORM_OWNER assignment and does not synthesize or impersonate a role.
The requested authority remains CONTROL_PLANE manage_staff with only staff-request:read and staff-request:approve, ticket PC-CROP-3785 and a 30-minute TTL.
The browser supplies current authentication, fresh MFA and CSRF; the backend remains the sole authorization and grant authority.
No break-glass path, direct database mutation, capability-token exposure, localStorage or sessionStorage authority is introduced.
The cryptographic inventory outputs are regenerated only by scripts/security/discover-cryptography.mjs against the merged branch tree; the scanner and policy tests are unchanged.
apps/landing, lockfiles, packages, production, REG.RU, DNS, credentials and database state are not changed by this branch.
The scope is exact to this branch and these seven paths; it does not widen the globally active autopilot scope.
acceptance: The owner can request and activate the bounded staff session and the page reloads the protected registration queue under that active session.
The owner access-center source contract passes for role authority, exact permissions, CSRF, no break-glass, mobile layout and RU/EN/ZH copy.
node --test scripts/security/*.test.mjs scripts/ip/*.test.mjs passes, including the committed-inventory staleness check.
scripts/p7-autopilot-guard.sh accepts exactly the four functional files, two generated inventory files and this manifest.
